summary: Neighborhood Intelligence, Inc., formerly Bed Bath & Beyond/Overstock, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement reducing its at-the-market (ATM) equity program maximum aggregate offering price from $200 million to $75 million, executed via Amendment No. 1 to its August 4, 2026 Capital on Demand Sales Agreement with JonesTrading Institutional Services LLC as sales agent. Only approximately $2.9 million of gross proceeds had been sold under the prior program. This is a routine shelf takedown modification rather than a special situation; no board recommendation, premium, or deal terms are disclosed. Watch for dilution pace and share overhang.
